rows.en: there was no end of poachers illegally hunting the whales for the black market,
and the Zolan Star Patrol, guarding the whales, struggled with armed poachers.
And now, once again this year, the season of the Galaxy Whales had come...
was sailing near the center of the galaxy.
rows.notes: Predicate only: the subject sits in the two lines before it, which reuse shared strings (very likely u3944/u3945: A.D. 2059 ... the 25th fleet, 'Macross Frontier,'). Written to follow 'the "Macross Frontier,"'.

rows.en: Inside the ships, an environment no different from Earth's had been artificially created,
and over 10 million people lived there, mainly on the residential ship...
rows.notes: Japanese: over 10 million lived, centered on the residential ship(s) (kyojuukan).

rows.en: The Macross Galaxy fleet was also sailing nearby,
and the two fleets, Galaxy and Frontier, kept close ties.
rows.notes: Japanese: (the Galaxy fleet) had mutual exchanges with the Frontier fleet.

rows.en: Then, from the Galaxy, came the diva known as the "Galactic Fairy,"
rows.notes: Sentence runs into u3997; Japanese is historical present ('comes to Frontier on a live tour'); rendered in past like the rest of the narration.

rows.en: "Sheryl Nome," bringing her concert tour to Frontier.
rows.notes: Sheryl's name is in brackets in the Japanese; kept as quotes.

rows.en: And it was from there that a new threat to humanity began to stir...
February 11, A.D. 2010.
The battle for Earth's fate, between the U.N. Forces and the Boddole Zer Main Fleet,
rows.notes: Boddole Zer Main Fleet per organizations.json (bodoru kikan kantai).

rows.en: thanks to Lynn Minmay's song and the aid of Vrlitwhai's Adoclass fleet, which it moved,
rows.notes: Fleet name 'Adoclass' not in glossary (Japanese: Buritai Adokurasu kantai). Rendered "Vrlitwhai's Adoclass fleet".

rows.en: ended in a U.N. Forces victory. Earthlings and Zentradi made peace and chose to coexist.
In the years since, Earth faced alien threats time and time again,
but each time pulled through thanks to variable fighters and the power of song.
Time went by, and it was now A.D. 2090. The Macross that once saved Earth lay in ruin,
rows.notes: Japanese has seireki mid-line; A.D. kept since this is the era's establishing year.

rows.en: and humanity flourished alongside the micronized Zentradi.
But a new threat was steadily creeping up on humanity...
In an instant, the attack of the Boddole Zer Main Fleet left Earth in ruins.
Only one weapon could stand against the overwhelming might of the Zentradi:
Minmay's song, and nothing else.
If Zentradi soldiers, who had never known Culture, were made to hear a song,
rows.notes: TM had lowercase 'culture'; glossary term is 'Culture'.

rows.en: the shock would surely throw them into chaos.
Clinging to that faint hope, the Macross set out for the final battle.
Minmay's song was relayed by Vrlitwhai's flagship
to every ship in the Zentradi fleet.
Just as predicted, the Zentradi forces fell into chaos.
Staking humanity's fate, the Macross advanced on the heart of the enemy.
Its target: Supreme Commander Boddole Zer's flagship, the Fulbtzs-Berrentzs.
With Minmay's song ringing out, the Macross plunged into the enemy flagship.
Boddole Zer fell before the Macross's all-out attack.
Having lost their command at the center, the Zentradi
no longer had the strength to stand against the Macross and Vrlitwhai's fleet.
And with the battle over, the Macross returned to Earth.
Two races created by the Protoculture,
the people of Earth and the Zentradi.
With the end of the war, the two began to walk a single path together.
But the embers of conflict between them had not yet completely died out...
Quamzin, unable to accept Culture and refusing to coexist with Earth's people,
rows.notes: TM had lowercase 'culture'; glossary term is 'Culture'.

rows.en: turned peaceful Macross City into a battlefield.
But the Macross rose again, and its main cannon set Quamzin's ship ablaze,
and Quamzin and his crew vanished into the flames.
And so Quamzin's rebellion came to an end.
The Macross was badly damaged in this battle, but meanwhile, a new spaceship
was being built: a colony ship to seek a new world beyond the solar system.
To protect their Culture, humanity set out on a great journey across the galaxy...
At Macross City's ceremony marking 30 years since the end of Space War I,
Sharon Apple, who had already become self-aware,
hacked into the Macross's main computer
and seized control of Macross City's entire information network.
She even went so far as to put the people of the whole city under mind control.
Meanwhile, two fighters were heading for Macross City.
They were the YF-19 and YF-21, prototypes whose development was frozen.
Sharon tried to destroy them with the X-9 Ghost drone and the Macross, but
thanks to their machines' astonishing power and the pilots' desperate stand,
the core of the information network was destroyed. Sharon was dead.
And so the Macross's rampage under Sharon Apple was brought to a halt.
The incident was classified top secret, known only to a few insiders, but
it brought the danger of rogue unmanned fighters and artificial intelligence
to light as a serious problem.
In the end, the full-scale introduction of the Ghost was shelved,
and along with that, the development of manned fighters was resumed.
The nearly derailed development competition ended in victory for the YF-19,
which was officially adopted as the VF-19 Excalibur.
Meanwhile, the losing YF-21's capabilities were also highly rated,
and it was later given its chance to shine as the high-performance VF-22.
And so, at the same time and in the same place, two legendary machines were born.
rows.notes: meiki = celebrated machines (the VF-19 and VF-22).

rows.en: The war against the Protodeviln, led by the immensely powerful Gepelnitchi,
had come to an end.
Just as in Space War I,
it was the power of the songs of Basara Nekki and friends that ended the war.
Once able to survive only by absorbing the Spiritia of other living things,
the Protodeviln, by singing together with Basara,
evolved into a race able to produce Spiritia on their own.
And so, with no more need to steal Spiritia, the Protodeviln
departed for some unknown, faraway corner of space.
Afterwards, Basara went on to make his mark as the vocalist of Fire Bomber
and became a singer whose voice thundered across the galaxy.

u4005: A.D. used though the year is not at the start of the Japanese line (cf. u3917, where the TM leaves A.D. out).
